results.description: Room names violating ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,47}$ must be rejected

evidence.body: 400 bad name 'Invalid Room!': expected /^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,47}$/ — lowercase letters, digits, - and _, 1-48 characters, starting with a letter or digit. Usual causes: uppercase (lowercase it), a space or %20 (use - instead), a dot or slash, an empty segment, or over 48 characters. This rule covers <room>, <nick>, <ns> and <key>; only <text> and <value> are free-form.

results.description: A message exceeding the 4096 char limit must be rejected

evidence.body_snippet: 400 text too long: 4237 characters, and the limit is 4096. Split it, or send it as a body — POST /r/<room> {"text":...} and POST /kv/<ns>/<key> {"value":...} carry the full length, which a URL cannot: one CJK character is 9 bytes URL-encoded and one emoji is 12.
